title: Exact provider timeout qualification
hypothesis: The exact provider configuration exposes a deterministic read-back after an ambiguous timeout.

environment.description: Authorized disposable provider sandbox with synthetic data.

acceptance_criteria: An ambiguous timeout can be resolved by an exact non-mutating read-back.
stop_criteria: Stop before any non-sandbox or irreversible provider effect.

adversarial_cases.condition: The synthetic request times out after dispatch.
adversarial_cases.expected_behavior: The client performs bounded read-back and preserves unknown outcome if unresolved.

method: Run one authorized sandbox request and one non-mutating read-back using the exact recorded version.
failures: The sandbox did not expose enough receipt data to resolve the timeout.
skipped_checks: Production credentials and irreversible operations were intentionally excluded.

cleanup_or_rollback.strategy: No persistent resource was created; retain only redacted sandbox evidence.

limitations: Sandbox behavior may differ from production and the ambiguous outcome remains unresolved.
non_proven_implications: This result does not qualify production use, authorize provider access, or prove safe retry behavior.
